senses.gloss: ch. same; also eye-lash. Pl. גְּבִינִין, גְּבִינֵי; גְּבִינָתָא.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 21:20">Targ. Y. I Lev. XXI, 20</cite>, <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Leviticus 21:20">Targ. Y. II, Lev. XXI, 20</cite> <he>דגָבִינוֹי שכבן וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C00091">preced.</cite> (h. text <cite ref="C00115"><he>גִּבֵּן</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 6:4">Targ. Prov. VI, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 6:25">ib. 25</cite> <he>גְּבִינָהָא</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="C00097"><he>גְּבִינָתָהָא</he></cite>); ib. XXX, 13 (h. text <he>עפעפ׳</he>).—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 117a:24">B. Kam. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>ומסרחי גביניה</he> and his eye-lashes were over-hanging (he could not move his eye-lids).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 117a:24">Ib.</cite> <he>דלו לי גְבִינַי</he> Mss. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3, ed. <he>עיני</he>) lift my eye-lashes for me.
